rounds.text: The long-term performance of Asian Hotels (East) Ltd reveals a structural inability to generate consistent shareholder value, evidenced by a 10-year median return on equity of only 2% [E26]. While recent figures show improvement, the company’s historical inability to sustain profitability is highlighted by a 5-year median ROE of just 5% [E27]. Furthermore, the company is currently underperforming its sector peers in critical efficiency metrics, with an ROA of -8.35% compared to the sector benchmark of 2.23% [E8] and an ROE of -3.48% against the sector's 6.94% [E9]. The recent quarterly operating margin has also contracted significantly, falling 8 percentage points year-over-year to 33% [E31]. Additionally, the company’s ROCE of 5.39% remains notably lower than the sector benchmark of 7.99% [E10]. Conceded: [E1], [E12], [E30].
